title: Exactly one count is even: a symmetric difference
notes: A accepts an even number of a's, B an even number of b's. The symmetric difference accepts a word when exactly one of the two counts is even: the pairs (p0, q1) and (p1, q0).
ops: start p0; accept p0; p0 a -> p1; p1 a -> p0; p0 b -> p0; p1 b -> p1 | start q0; accept q0; q0 a -> q0; q0 b -> q1; q1 a -> q1; q1 b -> q0
